title: Foundation Agents Meet Agentic Deep Research: Evidence-Grounded Clinical Code Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.17075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Next-encounter ICD forecasting predicts which standardized diagnosis codes will be documented at a future visit from the longitudinal record available beforehand. The task is prospective and multi-label: the target note does not yet exist, and several codes may be correct. Structured EHR foundation models capture recurrence and temporal progression, whereas language foundation models generate flexible diagnostic hypotheses. We introduce ICD-Deepresearch, a DeepResearch workflow that composes these predictive foundation models with medical search and ICD dictionaries. Because no source reveals the future code set, research evaluates candidate transitions by linking patient evidence, external clinical relations, and exact code semantics under a fixed top-K budget. Candidate Generation uses SparseEHR to produce an EHR Prior that initializes two bounded Research Expansion rounds; an independent GPT-5 Direct Forecast supplies complementary

translated_title: 基础模型遇上智能体深度研究：基于证据的临床代码预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17075v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：下次就诊的ICD编码预测旨在根据事先可获得的纵向病历记录，预测未来就诊时会记录的标准化诊断代码。该任务是前瞻性和多标签的：目标记录尚不存在，且可能有多个正确代码。结构化电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型捕捉疾病复发和时间进展，而语言基础模型则生成灵活的诊断假设。我们引入了ICD-Deepresearch，一种深度研究工作流，它将预测性基础模型与医学搜索和ICD字典相结合。由于没有来源能揭示未来的代码集，研究通过关联患者证据、外部临床关系和精确代码语义，在固定的top-K预算下评估候选转换。候选生成使用SparseEHR产生EHR先验，初始化两轮有界的研究扩展；一个独立的GPT-5直接预测提供补充。
tldr: 本文提出ICD-Deepresearch，一种结合EHR基础模型、医学搜索和ICD字典的深度研究工作流，用于前瞻性多标签ICD代码预测，通过证据关联和语义匹配在固定预算下评估候选诊断代码。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ICD-Deepresearch, a deep research workflow combining EHR foundation models, medical search, and ICD dictionaries for prospective multi-label ICD code forecasting, evaluating candidate diagnoses through evidence linkage and semantic matching under a fixed budget.
